sentences.english: Today is Monday.

sentences.text: Hay mucha gente en la clínica.
sentences.english: There are many people at the clinic.

sentences.text: Sam ayuda a Ana, mira y aprende.
sentences.english: Sam helps Ana, watches and learns.

sentences.text: Ana trabaja de las ocho a las cinco con Daniel.
sentences.english: Ana works from eight to five with Daniel.

sentences.text: Hay que esperar mucho tiempo, y Sam lleva agua a la gente.
sentences.english: People have to wait a long time, and Sam brings water to the people.

sentences.text: Una señora está con un cipote.
sentences.english: A woman is with a boy.

sentences.text: El cipote juega solo con un juego pequeño.
sentences.english: The boy plays alone with a small game.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Good morning, ma'am.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Do you want water?

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.english: Yes, thank you.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.english: I come from the village.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Subí al autobús a las cinco.
sentences.english: I got on the bus at five.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: And you got off in the city?

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.text: Sí, y caminé hasta la clínica.
sentences.english: Yes, and I walked to the clinic.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I also learn a lot here.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Now I wait with you.

sentences.speaker: P
sentences.english: Do you work at the clinic?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I help a little.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Hoy mi trabajo es llevar agua.
sentences.english: Today my job is bringing water.

sentences.text: El cipote mira a Sam y dice: "Quiero agua".
sentences.english: The boy looks at Sam and says: "I want water".
Sam gives water to the boy.

sentences.text: Ahora Ana habla con un señor, el señor Mario.
sentences.english: Now Ana talks with a man, Mr Mario.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Good morning, Mr Mario.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: What is wrong with you?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Good morning, nurse.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Tengo tos y me duele la garganta.
sentences.english: I have a cough and my throat hurts.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Do you have a fever?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Anoche tuve fiebre y no dormí.
sentences.english: Last night I had a fever and I did not sleep.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Do you feel pain in your body?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Sí, siento dolor en todo el cuerpo.
sentences.english: Yes, I feel pain in my whole body.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: How long have you had the cough?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Two days.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Pero ahora también tengo sangre en la nariz.
sentences.english: But now I also have blood in my nose.

sentences.text: Ana mira la nariz del señor.
sentences.english: Ana looks at the man's nose.
There is a little blood.

sentences.text: Luego mira la boca y la garganta.
sentences.english: Then she looks at his mouth and throat.

sentences.text: El señor Mario vive solo en un pueblo.
sentences.english: Mr Mario lives alone in a village.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: What happened, Mr Mario?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Anteayer estuve en una fiesta en el pueblo.
sentences.english: The day before yesterday I was at a party in the village.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I danced a lot, and it rained.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Maybe it is the rain.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: It is possible.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Estoy segura de que no es nada grande.
sentences.english: I am sure it is nothing big.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Usted tiene una cita con el doctor.
sentences.english: You have an appointment with the doctor.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Good morning, Mr Mario.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: I am Doctor Daniel.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: You have a cough and a fever.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: It is a small illness.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: The nose is fine.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: There is not much blood.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: But your throat is bad.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: You must take care of your body.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Debe quedarse en la casa y tomar mucha agua.
sentences.english: You must stay at home and drink a lot of water.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Do you live alone?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Yes, alone.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: My family lives far away.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Entonces Ana va a llamar a su familia.
sentences.english: Then Ana is going to call your family.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: I am going to write a prescription.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Debe tomar una pastilla en la mañana, una en la tarde y una en la noche.
sentences.english: You must take one pill in the morning, one in the afternoon and one at night.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: How many days?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Five days.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Después regresa a la clínica con otra cita.
sentences.english: Then you come back to the clinic with another appointment.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Thank you, doctor.

sentences.text: Ana lee la receta con el señor Mario.
sentences.english: Ana reads the prescription with Mr Mario.
One pill in the morning.
One pill at night.
Drink a lot of water.
Stay at home.
Do not go to the beach.
Do not go on the walk.
Do not go to the party.

sentences.text: Cuidar la salud es bueno para la familia.
sentences.english: Taking care of your health is good for the family.

sentences.text: La cita es en cinco días.
sentences.english: The appointment is in five days.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Enfermera, ¿puedo llevar la receta al pueblo?
sentences.english: Nurse, can I take the prescription to the village?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Of course.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Pero hoy usted se queda en la ciudad.
sentences.english: But today you stay in the city.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Tomorrow you go back.

sentences.text: Después de la clínica, Sam y Ana toman café.
sentences.english: After the clinic, Sam and Ana drink coffee.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Ana, I learned a lot today.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Good.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: What did you learn?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Aprendí que hay que cuidar la salud.
sentences.english: I learned that we have to take care of our health.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿La enfermedad del señor Mario es difícil?
sentences.english: Is Mr Mario's illness a hard one?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: No, it is a small illness.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Así es el trabajo de todos los días.
sentences.english: That is how the work is every day.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: La salud es un regalo de Dios.
sentences.english: Health is a gift from God.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Tengo tiempo el fin de semana.
sentences.english: I have time on the weekend.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Can I come back?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Of course, Sam.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: There is always work.

sentences.text: La clínica termina a las cinco.
sentences.english: The clinic closes at five.

sentences.text: Ana y Sam caminan a la casa de doña Marta.
sentences.english: Ana and Sam walk to doña Marta's house.

sentences.text: Doña Marta cocina frijoles y arroz, y todos cenan.
sentences.english: Doña Marta cooks beans and rice, and everybody has dinner.
